Currently, I scale business intelligence by implementing extraction pipelines on ERP ecosystems, while developing predictive models (Machine Learning) aimed at solving complex problems in various sectors, including public health, finance, and research.

introduction.aboutContent:
I am a software engineer specialized in Data. I transform complex volumes of information into decisions. My focus lies in building predictive models, extracting business value through data mining, and automating data pipelining to eliminate uncertainty in the corporate environment.

By incorporating these capabilities, my work achieves greater operational agility, attaining profitability. By integrating data-oriented software solutions, I make it easier for teams to shift from reaction to proactivity. This not only optimizes resource performance, but also ensures that each new strategy is backed by quantifiable evidence.

img5.title: Budget Control
img5.desc: I develop a data extraction and processing solution for the finance department with the goal of mitigating operational risks by analytically monitoring variances between actual and budgeted expenses. I automate the data flow from accounts payable (AP) invoices and general ledger (GL) journal entries of the Oracle system, consolidating and normalizing scattered charts of accounts, departments, and locations using relational databases in SQL Server. I structure the computational logic in C# to cross-reference these financial variables and automatically transform operational data into structured, calculated information files using EPPlus. This enables the generation of clean datasets that facilitate advanced cash flow analysis and empower financial decision-making, supported by an ASP.NET Core 8.0 MVC architecture and Microsoft Identity for access management.

img3.title: Labels
img3.desc: I design and build a solution oriented towards data extraction and automation for the Warehouse area, focused on optimizing the traceability of supplier information associated with each product. I extract and process critical variables, such as the Supplier Part Number and Daikin Part Number, by consuming APIs connected to Oracle databases. I transform this data flow into a structured and physical format by automatically generating labels and barcodes using the iText library. By coupling this information with a configuration model based on JSON files, I guarantee the tool's scalability without needing to modify the code, reducing logistical processing times by more than 50%.

img4.title: MasterLabels Analysis
img4.desc: I develop a web analytical platform (ASP.NET and MySQL) focused on diagnosing and resolving a critical and recurring quality issue that caused the printing of 300 to 8,000 blank labels per month, generating a severe impact of logistical rework. I structure the ingestion of large data volumes by capturing granular variables from each label (such as LPN, production line, order numbers, and process times), exporting and transforming this information into dashboards and pivot tables for evaluation. Through this analysis, I manage to isolate patterns, identify that incidents predominate on two specific lines, and discover that the root cause is a technical desynchronization between physical scanning speed and system assignment. This exact diagnosis, backed 100% by data, supports the implementation of a latency adjustment in the Oracle environment, successfully dropping the failure rate by 90%.

img2.title: Overtime Request
img2.desc: I manage and optimize a data processing platform oriented towards the finance department, designed to calculate and automate costs generated by logistics and food services during production personnel's overtime. I process and cross-reference multiple structured operational variables—such as supervisor records, transport routes, and logistics stops—to generate financial calculations that facilitate expense control and internal auditing. I support this business logic using a C# and ASP.NET architecture, integrating SSO authentication protocols to ensure the integrity, protection, and secure access of corporate information.

img1.title: Database Development & Architecture
img1.desc: I analyze and architect the PostgreSQL model for the Odoo ERP ecosystem deployment. I translate the company's business rules and operational processes into a robust and scalable database structure, guaranteeing information integrity and optimizing performance for the ingestion, connection, and extraction of large volumes of data across different business modules.

img2.title: Server Management & Administration
img2.desc: I design, structure, and program a customized internal platform developed in Python and PostgreSQL for the centralized management of Odoo ERP modules/instances. I automate the continuous monitoring of global server performance, streamline the editing of critical security configurations, and execute database maintenance, successfully mitigating downtime due to technical incidents.

img3.title: SAJI Analytical Dashboards
img3.desc: I build and implement Business Intelligence solutions by developing multidimensional analytical dashboards. I extract and transform raw operational data into real-time interactive visualizations, allowing the tracking of KPIs in areas such as Sales, Inventories, and Finance, which facilitates management's evaluation of personnel performance, goal tracking, and support for data-driven decision making.

img4.title: Data Performance Monitor
img4.desc: I develop an analytical tool oriented towards auditing and supervising the health of the technology ecosystem and database integrity. I extract and process performance metrics and state variables to identify infrastructure bottlenecks, guaranteeing the operational stability of the Odoo environment and ensuring that commercial and financial information flows operate without interruption.

wids2025.name: WiDS Datathon 2025
wids2025.description: Building a Machine Learning classification model focused on the early detection of ADHD, mitigating historical diagnostic bias in women.
wids2025.h1: Deep cleaning and preprocessing of medical datasets.
wids2025.h2: Training of XGBoost model for high-precision classification.
wids2025.h3: Multiclass classification model with XGBoost for ADHD/ADD detection.
wids2025.h4: Feature engineering on neuroimaging data to improve class separability.
wids2025.h5: Feature importance analysis to identify the most relevant diagnostic factors.
wids2025.h6: Complete pipeline for cleaning, normalization, and preprocessing of neurological data.

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2025: ADHD Prediction in Adolescent Girls
img1.desc: I design and implement a predictive Machine Learning model in Python, using the XGBoost algorithm, to detect ADHD in adolescent girls and mitigate historical clinical bias in its diagnosis. I execute a comprehensive data cleaning and preparation pipeline to feed the algorithm, evaluating its success through accuracy metrics, confusion matrices, and predictive performance charts. By visualizing feature importance, I isolate and demonstrate exactly which neurological and behavioral variables carry the most weight in predicting the disorder, ensuring the model's results are not only accurate but fully interpretable for analysis in healthcare settings.

wids2022.name: WiDS Datathon 2022
wids2022.description: Statistical and predictive analysis on medical and sociodemographic datasets to forecast definitive diagnoses in periods under 90 days.
wids2022.h1: Feature engineering on complex clinical records.
wids2022.h2: Performance metrics optimization and validation using AUC-ROC curves.

img1.title: WiDS Datathon 2022: Early Detection of Breast Cancer
img1.desc: I execute statistical analyses and develop predictive Machine Learning models in Python focused on the early detection of breast cancer. I process medical and sociodemographic datasets using advanced normalization and feature engineering techniques, with the goal of forecasting diagnoses within a period of less than 90 days. I evaluate and guarantee the algorithm's reliability in a sensitive clinical context by optimizing performance metrics, validating its accuracy and predictive power through AUC-ROC curves.
